title: Five habits that help you move from SLP 2 to 2+
summary: Small things you can do every week that make a real difference.
body:
Moving up a level is less about big efforts and more about small habits.

## 1. Listen every day
Ten minutes is enough. A podcast on the way to work counts.

## 2. Write something short every week
An email, a summary of the news, a paragraph about your weekend. Use Write & Improve for feedback.

## 3. Keep a vocabulary notebook
Not single words: whole phrases. "Take responsibility for", not just "responsibility".

## 4. Speak, even alone
Describe what you are doing while you cook or drive. It feels strange, but it works.

## 5. Read one article a week a little above your level
You don't need to understand everything. Aim for the main idea.
